canonical_title: Bikebuster: Automation System that Detects Motorcycle on Footpaths and Reports to Authority
aliases: Bikebuster: Automation System that detects motorcycle on footpaths and report to Authority
abstract: The Bikebuster project is an automated system designed to detect motorcycles illegally riding on sidewalks and report offenders to the authorities. The primary goal of the project is to enhance safety for pedestrians by reducing the number of motorcycles on sidewalks, which pose a significant safety risk. In addition, the illegal use of sidewalks can cause damage to footpaths, exacerbating the problem. The Bikebuster project is motivated by the need to address these issues and improve enforcement of existing laws and regulations. The system uses a combination of hardware and software components to detect and capture images of offending motorcycles, which are then reported to the authorities via a reporting website. The project has the potential to generate passive income by sharing fines imposed on offenders with the system operator. However, safety remains the top priority in the implementation of this system. Overall, the Bikebuster project aims to improve safety for pedestrians and reduce the damage caused by illegal activity on sidewalks.

abstract: This paper discusses our unity game project called “The Grand Collection”, a horror game that aims to offer an engaging and challenging experience for players. The game is designed to challenge the player with time-based objectives, making it an exciting and entertaining gaming experience. This paper aims to give readers an understanding of how the game was created and how it challenges players by providing details about the development process of the game, including its design, features, model assets and mechanics.

abstract: This report outlines the development of an integrated order management system for online merchants with multiple shops on platforms such as Shopee and Lazada. The system allows merchants to gather all orders from different online platforms into one central system, enabling them to see all their orders in a single view. Additionally, the system provides tools for merchants to create vouchers and coupons that can be redeemed by customers who purchase products from any of their shops, regardless of the platform. Customers can view their point balances and available coupons via a Line Official Account, where they are required to login using their name and phone number. The report concludes that this system can help merchants manage their online sales more effectively and build stronger customer relationships through targeted promotions and rewards.
